capabilities: insert a configured emoji at the beginning of the active note's title via a hotkey
replace an existing title emoji with a different one
delete the title emoji using the same shortcut
configure which emojis are available and how many
disambiguation: It only modifies the note's title text, not the note body or file name display.
extras: Also supports manual installation via GitHub releases ZIP.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to quickly add an emoji to a note's title for visual distinction, such as marking notes as read or indicating depth.
summary: Keyboard-shortcut plugin that inserts, replaces, or removes an emoji at the start of the active note's title.
